sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.115 - Dev

  • Fixed Global Admin Floating Launcher Icon (FAB) Visibility: Reverted the restrictive enqueue guard in AdminAdapter.php. The settings panel asset (builder-panel.js) is now loaded globally across all WordPress Admin screens again, restoring the bottom-right floating gear launcher button (speed dial FAB) as expected by the user. Generated CSS files (variables.css, advanced.css) remain strictly restricted to the MV settings page to prevent generic styling leaks.
  • Fixed Keyboard Shortcut/Keybind Hijacking: Added element input guards to Alt+Z (builder-panel.js) and matchesShortcut/Alt+Q (global-event-manager.js) keydown listeners. Keyboard events originating from input, textarea, select, and contenteditable elements on other admin pages are now safely ignored, preventing Mimam's Var/Mimam's Bar from intercepting standard typing input.
  • Fixed Bricks Save State for Bulk Operations: Mutating settings on reactive proxies property-by-property was not recognized by Vue since nested properties on raw/new objects are not deeply observed by Bricks' top-level Vue watchers. Overwriting element.settings directly with the nextSettings clone now fires Vue's Proxy setter hooks correctly. Additionally, bulk commits now push 'components' into Bricks' native state.unsavedChanges array, activating the Bricks Save button and enabling changes to persist.

v1.3.114 - Dev

  • Fixed Bulk Actions — Reactive Proxy Preservation: walkElements and findElementInList were unwrapping the element list array with _toRaw(list), so list[i] returned raw JS objects stripped of Vue reactivity. Mutations on raw objects are invisible to Vue. Fix: iterate the original proxy array directly so every element returned is a live Vue reactive proxy.
  • Fixed Style and Functionality Leakage into Other Plugin Interfaces: Restricted the enqueue hook to fire only when page=variable-engine (the plugin's own settings page). Also restricted the global generated CSS enqueue (variables.css, advanced.css) in variable-engine.php to the same condition.
  • Fixed FOUC Script Leaking to Public Frontend: Guarded wp_head inline script injection to run only when bricks=run query parameter is present.

v1.3.113 - Dev

  • Synchronized Canvas Rerender for Bulk Modifications (state.rerenderElementIds): Pushed modified element IDs directly to Bricks Vue state array state.rerenderElementIds. This triggers Bricks' native iframe message-dispatcher to synchronize settings to the canvas and force component re-renders.
